issues.summary: Replace iptables link in logging.md; new wiki.ubuntu.com URL is a 404
issues.detail: docs/reference/configuration-guides/logging.md:16 changes the iptables link to https://wiki.ubuntu.com/IptablesHowTo, which is a dead page. gemini-3.1-pro-preview says the old help.ubuntu.com/community/IptablesHowTo URL was correct and asks to revert; claude-opus-5 and deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017 verified the old URL now redirects to the same 404 and propose a live replacement (e.g. https://documentation.ubuntu.com/server/how-to/security/firewalls/ or the netfilter packet-filtering HOWTO).

issues.summary: Fix 'Secure your deployment with HTTP' to HTTPS in air-gapped guide
issues.detail: docs/how-to-guides/set-up-air-gapped-maas.md:18 (just above the edited line 20) tells readers to secure the Enterprise Store deployment with HTTP; for a store serving snaps to restricted networks this should read HTTPS. Out of the diff but in the same section.

issues.summary: Fix dead maas.io tags-doc link in deploy-dpus-without-bmc.md:18
issues.detail: Not in this diff but the same class of breakage: docs/how-to-guides/deploy-dpus-without-bmc.md:18 links to https://maas.io/docs/how-to-work-with-tags, which redirects to canonical.com/maas/docs/stable/how-to-guides/work-with-tags/ and 404s; the in-repo equivalent is /how-to-guides/manage-machine-groups.md#manage-tags-in-maas.

issues.summary: Run make linkcheck; it is not bypassed for wiki.ubuntu.com
issues.detail: linkcheck_ignore in docs/conf.py is nearly empty and does not exempt wiki.ubuntu.com, and make -C docs linkcheck is wired as a pre-commit hook (docs/.sphinx/.pre-commit-config.yaml:11), so the introduced 404 would be flagged; running linkcheck on this branch is the cheap verification for a link-refresh PR.

issues.summary: Simplify manage-machines link text; drop stale escaped hyphen
issues.detail: docs/how-to-guides/deploy-dpus.md:425 now points at an internal page (/how-to-guides/manage-machines.md), so the 'MAAS Documentation \-' prefix is redundant and the escaped hyphen only existed for the old external title; e.g. '[Manage machines](/how-to-guides/manage-machines.md)' is clearer.

issues.summary: Normalize trailing double-space hard breaks in deploy-dpus.md list
issues.detail: docs/how-to-guides/deploy-dpus.md:425 lost its trailing two-space hard break while sibling lines 426-428 keep theirs; harmless inside a list but inconsistent, normalize all four.

issues.summary: Link enterprise-store how-to page instead of docs landing page
issues.detail: docs/how-to-guides/set-up-air-gapped-maas.md:20 links https://ubuntu.com/enterprise-store/docs/ (verified 200, and the old URL already 301s here); https://ubuntu.com/enterprise-store/docs/how-to is closer to the offline/air-gapped procedure being described.

issues.summary: Fix dead maas.io URL embedded in join-our-forum.md form prefill
issues.detail: Out of this diff: docs/uncategorized/join-our-forum.md:3 embeds a dead maas.io/docs URL as a Google Form prefill value; cosmetic only, but the same class of stale link this PR is cleaning up.
